editionLabel: Schmidt Spiele/Drei Magier German rules summarized in English
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently got lost begins.
clarifications: Play then proceeds in turn order. This is the standard magnetic labyrinth board game; the publisher also lists a separate travel edition.

internalEvidence: The current Schmidt Spiele product page https://www.schmidtspiele.de/details/produkt/das-magische-labyrinth.html links article 40848. The linked 16-page image-only booklet was rendered and German printed page 6 read visually. Under Spielverlauf it states 'Gespielt wird reihum. Der Spieler, der sich zuletzt verlaufen hat, beginnt.' The three-language booklet shows German, French and Italian sections despite GB in its filename. This answer is an English summary of the German text.
